title: Rescue five orphaned open-thread handoffs
intent: Commit five dev orders / handoffs, each the input document to a thread that was started but never merged. None had been committed to any branch in any repository - git log --all returned nothing for all five - so each was the sole copy of an input to live, unfinished work. Content is byte-identical; nothing is edited.
behavior_change: None. Documentation only. Preserves the inputs and makes no claim about the status or disposition of the five threads, which remain open on unmerged branches.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds 5 previously-uncommitted document(s) at their native path(s), verbatim.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: These files existed nowhere in git. Verified with `git log --all --oneline -- <path>`, which returned nothing for every one. Without this commit each is one disk failure from being lost.

commands_run: git log --all --oneline -- <path> -> no output for every file in this patch, confirming it was committed nowhere.
Byte-identity confirmed with diff against the rescued source before committing.
